Noncommand reviews bind to the selected enforcing acknowledgment; migration 29 preserves their scope alongside the original receipt table, and approval consumption remains atomic.

Current implementation: [`4d10758e2cb44e5afa72a08aa631a02541dad534`](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/commit/4d10758e2cb44e5afa72a08aa631a02541dad534), tree `fbc00caa3788eb422158a2263a578e83ac626183`. This preserves the intervening source through `8f15b37b` and adds the two reviewed diagnostics fixes with one regression control.

- Workspace observations share the actual captured acceptance-time origin. Absolute deadlines, current-policy authority and independent full-startup timing are preserved.
- The public scanner function loads on first access while retaining function identity, model exports, discovery, concurrent access and reload behavior. Scanner import side effects occur at first scanner access.
- Failure reports retain finite delivery facts and existing writer counters. They require the current diagnostics contract, use explicit failure-code branches, and preserve the original probe exception when diagnostic collection fails.
- Native receipt binding, atomic approval consumption, storage checks and the narrowly bounded macOS socket handling remain in place. The CLI test file and its 49 named partitions all satisfy the actual review limit: at most 344 nonblank lines, with a maximum of 421 physical lines.
- Request-local risk reuse (RSP-100) remains open. Its current helper work is separate from active production integration and does not establish performance benefit.

The published [PRD checkpoint](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/13a1520b056a6946d84cd18957bc2d075c67c695/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T055900Z-interim-4d107/PRD-checkpoint.md), [complete 144-task TODO](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/13a1520b056a6946d84cd18957bc2d075c67c695/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T055900Z-interim-4d107/TODO-current.md) and [Takeaway](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/13a1520b056a6946d84cd18957bc2d075c67c695/review-evidence/2026-09-19/pr2974-completion/addenda/20260920T055900Z-interim-4d107/TAKEAWAY.md) retain the original requirements, all 119 catalog records and the prior evidence. Their cutoff is 2026-09-20 05:59 UTC. This is an interim checkpoint; archived task statuses are preserved without promoting implementation or qualification claims. The addendum preserves all 5,284 prior files and adds 133 files.

| Evidence scope | Verified result and practical limit |
| --- | --- |
| Current `4d107`, normal native-wheel jobs | Windows and both Macs passed their jobs with 21 native decisions and 21 processed receipts each. Windows also records one `all_evidence: journal_checkpoint/os_permission` failure; its native-receipt failure map is empty. The Mac smoke gates pass with qualification false; Intel/ARM concurrency-16 p99 values of 704.768/298.514 ms exceed the original 200 ms qualification target. The Linux soak is still running. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35492742680). |
| Current `4d107`, Linux transport validation | Two initial policy snapshot pushes failed before the spoof/slow-client and overload scenarios began: 13 tests passed and two failed. The retained token `native_resident_live_request_failed` does not identify the internal cause or prove a timeout. [Failed job](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35492742596/job/106030357811). |
| Current `4d107`, corrected native validation | The new run requires the exact wheel hash during installation and independently checks the original archive, install command, origin and installed member/RECORD bytes. It is running; no result is claimed yet. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35493601886). |
| `0a6`, fixed 349-case validation | All 349 cases, 1,047 phases and ordered JUnit rows passed, with source quality, ownership and cleanup checks. The 23,294-node collection was collection only. This remains evidence for its exact earlier source. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35488738407). |
| `d1ba`, corrected 276-case validation | All 276 cases, 828 phases and ordered JUnit rows passed. All 21 parent commands passed, including the original storage controls, separate recorder control and process cleanup. The earlier incomplete 276 attempt remains retained. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35491137938). |
| `d1ba`, first supplemental 593-case validation | 340 cases and 1,020 phases passed; the remaining 253 bodies were unrun after a pytest 9.0.3 Cartesian-index admission failure. The whole suite failed, and all 200 original report members are retained. The corrected run on `4d107` is being prepared with the original 593 cases plus 41 separate cases for recent changes. [Original run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35490801471). |
| `d1ba`, prior corrected native validation | The 29 prerequisites, 24 native units, three consumers of actual Rust output, separate producer and six Python cases passed. Wheel construction and installation passed; both installed inventories failed because pinned uv omitted optional archive-hash metadata. The installed 1/10/100 workspace diagnostic never started. This failed attempt remains retained. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35490641762). |
| `8f15`, prior normal platform cohort | Linux completed 100,000 responses and 250,000 receipts with zero request/health failures and one stable daemon. Both Macs passed their normal smoke jobs. Windows failed during auth-token replacement with WinError 32. Later successes do not explain or erase that failure. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35491138534). |
| `8f15`, isolated Windows reader diagnostic | Holding the destination token open produced WinError 5 where the frozen diagnostic expected 32. That diagnostic failed and does not reproduce the historical startup error. Its original result is retained; separate source/destination handle controls are being prepared. [Run](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35492720092). |

Both diagnostics review findings are fixed in the published source. All 59 current review threads were verified resolved at 06:00:49 UTC. The latest retained Greptile score is still 4/5 on `8f15`; a fresh passing review of the final head and genuine independent last-push/CODEOWNER approval remain required. Thread resolution does not supply either approval.

The original comparison baseline remains `2e672d2d950c6ec471005ddba46e49bba16dc23b`. Full acceptance still requires the original installed route/control coverage, matched-host sample populations, latency and process-resource targets, selected implementation work, signing/frozen-artifact checks, update/downgrade/rollback evidence and authorized canary work. The stopped E/F campaigns remain immutable and inactive. Source review, small smoke populations and standalone soaks do not establish full performance qualification.

This PR does not yet establish complete implementation, full qualification, approval, activation or release. The earlier PR description and all failed attempts remain preserved in the linked evidence history.
